name: process-speed
description: A building's Speed entry in its detail panel's status strip: a level 1 Mine at the 100% base shows none; after Better Mining I it reads +25% in green with the research named; a Drill Rig in a blackout reads -100% in the warning tone, its tooltip adding its level and research parts and the blackout's share; powered, it reads +100% in green.

steps.comment: Iron Ore in range of both buildings; Small Hubs from the HQ put them online.
At 100% there is no Speed entry: the toggle and the network only.
A Drill Rig with no Power supply is in a blackout.

equals.tip: +75% from level 2 building, +25% from Better Mining I, x0% from Power blackout: -100%

steps.comment: A Burner Generator on Coal powers it: 200%.

equals.tip: +75% from level 2 building, +25% from Better Mining I
